punchline: People who met Bill Clinton often said he made them feel like the only person in the room.
thirty_sec: In The Charisma Myth, Olivia Fox Cabane breaks charisma into power, warmth and presence, with presence as the foundation. People can tell when you're distracted: your eyes glaze and your reactions lag. That's why those who met Bill Clinton felt like the only person in the room. To return to the present, she suggests briefly focusing on your breath or even your toes.
question: Who in your life makes you feel like the only person in the room?
